baseline: B8 Clairvoyance (Tran et al., CGO 2017), artifact third_party/clairvoyance
usage:
make -C benchmarks ARCH=riscv VARIANT={clairvoyance|winhint_clairvoyance} CV_TYPE=.. CV_UNROLL=.. CV_INDIR=.. [CV_BRANCH_PROB=..]; non-default settings build into []-cv_-u-i[-bp

]
tuning: PROPOSAL §8: tune per kernel on the small input with the same budget as WinHint; the artifact itself evaluates the full grid below and keeps the best version per benchmark

CV_UNROLL.pass_options: -single-loop-unroll -unroll N (and -unroll N to the SWOOP pass)

CV_BRANCH_PROB.pass_options: -merge-branches -branch-prob-threshold P (fixed at 0.9 in the artifact recipe)

validated: all 60 grid points x 15 kernels compile with CV_STRICT=1 (no excluded function) and match plain bit for bit on the small input (native x86-64), 2026-10-01
